
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MikeZhang/p/19249529/fs-mod-fail2ban" title="发布于 2025-11-20 20:50">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">FreeSWITCH使用mod_fail2ban模块来提升安全</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div>操作系统：Debian 12.5_x64</div>
<div>FreeSWITCH版本： 1.10.11</div>
<div>fail2ban版本： 1.1.0</div>
<div>nftables版本： 1.0.6</div>
<p><span>FreeSWITCH系统部署在公网，大概率会碰到恶意注册，今天整理下debian12环境下使用mod_fail2ban + fail2ban + nftables来提升系统安全性的笔记，并提供使用示例及相关资源下载。</span></p>
<p><span>相关资源可从如下渠道获取：</span></p>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>
<h1 id="whpw-1763641415019">一、原理说明</h1>
<div>这里描述下mod_fail2ban如何使用fail2ban软件添加防护规则，实现ip地址封禁。</div>
<div>原理示意图如下：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202352924-1692226446.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>说明：</div>
<div>1）话机发起注册时，防火墙程序默认放行，注册请求会到达mod_sofia模块；</div>
<div>2）mod_sofia模块处理sip注册请求的过程中，会生成注册相关事件；</div>
<div>3）mod_fail2ban模块监听到注册事件后，进行过滤，根据既定规则生成fail2ban.log日志；</div>
<div>4）fail2ban程序解析fail2ban.log日志文件，根据配置规则添加防火墙策略；</div>
<div>5）防火墙程序使用新规则阻挡恶意注册；</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>fail2ban说明可参考GitHub描述，这里就不多说了。</div>
<div><a href="https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban</a></div>
<h1 id="PGSB-1763641481482">二、模块安装及配置&nbsp;</h1>
<h2>1、添加模块编译项</h2>
<div>文件：源码根目录的modules.conf文件</div>
<div>添加（或取消注释）如下代码：</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>event_handlers/mod_fail2ban</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202516086-2143229293.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span><span>2、编译及安装</span></span></h2>
<p><span>源码目录执行如下命令：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>autoreconf -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">fiv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clean
.</span>/devel-bootstrap.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> &amp;&amp; ./configure &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> &amp;&amp; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>说明：</span></p>
<p><span>1）会编译mod_fail2ban模块；</span></p>
<p><span>2）如果配置文件没有找到，可以从源码目录复制过去；</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cp</span> src/mod/event_handlers/mod_fail2ban/fail2ban.conf.xml /usr/local/freeswitch/conf/autoload_configs/</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202607966-950336929.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span><span>3、加载mod_fail2ban模块</span></span></h2>
<p><span>编辑 conf/autoload_configs/modules.conf.xml 文件，添加如下内容：</span></p>
</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;load module=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mod_fail2ban</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>/&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202641067-951237563.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;重启FreeSWITCH或执行重新load操作：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>load mod_fail2ban</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202749385-874866759.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;如果加载不报错，则添加mod_fail2ban 模块成功。</p>
<h2><span><span>4、配置模块</span></span></h2>
<p><span>配置文件路径：</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>/usr/local/freeswitch/conf/autoload_configs/fail2ban.conf.xml</pre>
</div>
<p><span>配置文件内容如下（默认）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="fail2ban.conf"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> description</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="fail2ban log configs"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bindings</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="settings"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> desription</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="configs"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">param </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="logfile"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> value</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="$${log_dir}/fail2ban.log"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bindings</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202853369-1976413305.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2><span><span>5、模块运行效果</span></span></h2>
<p><span>模块启动后，会自动创建日志文件，并写入相关日志。</span></p>
<p><span>默认日志路径：/usr/local/freeswitch/log/</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202917714-1680057335.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;日志效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120202934519-737176317.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="4mHk-1763641798108">三、安装fail2ban软件</h1>
<div>GitHub地址：</div>
<div><a href="https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban</a></div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203019617-1892088714.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>需要注意的是apt 安装的fail2ban软件版本是1.0.2，不能使用nftables，这里使用的是1.1.0版本，可从GitHub下载：</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><a href="https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban/releases" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/fail2ban/fail2ban/releases</a></div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203044107-1145610349.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>如果下载过慢，可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>安装命令如下：</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dpkg -i fail2ban_1.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.upstream1_all.deb</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203133178-2142941092.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;配置文件目录： /etc/fail2ban</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203154212-2088307438.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="IPgH-1763641933243">四、使用示例</h1>
<div>&nbsp;这里列举下使用示例。</div>
<h2 id="zPkS-1763641933251">1、配置防火墙</h2>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>这里使用nftables来过滤ip地址，该软件是debian12默认安装的，如果没有安装，可用如下命令进行安装：</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>apt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> nftables</pre>
</div>
<div>这里使用的nftables v1.0.6版本。</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203253773-171217730.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>2、配置fail2ban软件使用nftable</h2>
<p><span>/etc/fail2ban/action.d目录默认有nttables的动作配置：</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203316829-110603800.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;/etc/fail2ban/jail.conf文件默认有freeswitch配置，默认未启用：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203337182-44327207.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;为了方便演示，这里不使用默认的配置文件，修改后的 jail.conf 文件内容可从如下渠道获取：</p>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>
<h2>3、添加freeswitch过滤规则</h2>
<p><span>文件： filter.d/freeswitch-fail2ban.conf</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<p>文件内容可从如下渠道获取：</p>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>查看状态：</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>fail2ban-client status freeswitch-fail2ban</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203649680-977305126.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>4、开启nftable服务</h2>
<p><span>需要开启nftables服务：</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>systemctl start nftables</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203721924-694786054.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2><span><span>5、使用分机模拟注册失败</span></span></h2>
<p><span>分机： 1009</span></p>
<p><span>填写错误的注册密码，执行注册操作。</span></p>
<p><span>连续10次注册失败，会自动拉黑，运行效果如下：</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203823142-460759768.png" alt="bbe8de9acbd811216449533c8f7d6be4" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;到时间后，会自动解除：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203843454-1236349094.png" alt="66df47961c65f06e728a446bb50ab8bb" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;如需提前解除黑名单，可使用如下命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>/usr/bin/fail2ban-client set freeswitch-fail2ban unbanip <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">137.1</span></pre>
</div>
<p>运行效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120203929460-1320666710.png" alt="f4a189e090a9040caa71deae2fd23548" loading="lazy"></p>
<div>该部分涉及的配置文件，可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>
<h1 id="Vu4L-1763642421812">五、模块源码说明</h1>
<div>源码目录：</div>
<div>src/mod/event_handlers/mod_fail2ban/</div>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120204031131-145113491.png" alt="ef0bce2e81ab1c6bff88507e14eeb377" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span>源码只有一个文件： mod_fail2ban.c</span></p>
<h2>1、函数说明</h2>
<p><span>该模块有4个函数：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mod_fail2ban_do_config ： 模块配置解析函数
fail2ban_logger ： 生成fail2ban日志
fail2ban_event_handler ： 模块事件处理回调函数
mod_fail2ban_load  ： 模块加载函数
mod_fail2ban_shutdown ： 模块关闭函数 </span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120204109843-583626572.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>2、关键函数说明</h2>
<p><span>模块的加载、关闭及配置解析没什么说的，这里描述下该模块的fail2ban_event_handler函数。</span></p>
<div>关于该函数的描述，可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。&nbsp;</div>
<h1 id="KrfE-1763642545559">六、资源下载</h1>
<div>本文相关资源及示例配置，可从如下渠道获取：</div>
<div>关注微信公众号（聊聊博文，文末可扫码）后回复&nbsp;20251120&nbsp;获取。</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/300959/202511/300959-20251120204245559-145722300.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div><strong>【文件说明】</strong></div>
<div>fail2ban-1.1.0 : fail2ban-1.1.0源码及deb格式安装包</div>
<div>etc_fail2ban.tar.gz ： /etc/fail2ban目录打包文件</div>
<div>fail2ban模块.drawio ： drawio格式框架图</div>
<div>freeswitch-fail2ban.conf ： mod_fail2ban模块日志的过滤规则</div>
<div>jail.conf ： fail2ban配置</div>
<div>status1.sh ：fail2ban结果查看脚本</div>
</div>
